latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the type-code-refactoring-selector skill.
- Selects and executes the correct refactoring path for behavior-affecting type codes (enums, integer constants, string tags) using Fowler’s three-way decision tree.
- Covers Replace Type Code with Class, Replace Type Code with Subclasses, and Replace Type Code with State/Strategy; automates subsequent Replace Conditional with Polymorphism.
- Guides identification of type code location, value set, and switching logic across the codebase.
- Handles exceptions for simple or nullable cases; not intended for non-type-code-driven conditionals or structural smells.
- Target audience: intermediate developers working on refactoring object-oriented designs suffering from primitive obsession or scattered switch statements.
